cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.2.0)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0214 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/sessions/ecstatic-eloquent-darwin/mnt/csound7_tilde/PD/build/sndfile-static/build-linux-aarch64/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-kQp0FE")
add_executable(cmTC_c5755)
target_sources(cmTC_c5755 PRIVATE
  "/sessions/ecstatic-eloquent-darwin/.local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/cmake/data/share/cmake-4.4/Modules/CMakeCXXCompilerABI.cpp"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_c5755_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_c5755>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_c5755 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
